recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, cinematic scene featuring a solitary figure walking away from a house engulfed in intense, bright orange flames and thick dark smoke against a muted blue twilight sky, finished with a heavy vintage film texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Warmth of the fire vs. the cool blue of the sky and shadows
The calm indifference of the subject vs. the violent destruction of the house
Textural grit of the film grain unifying the composite elements
coreInvariants: Intense orange-yellow core in the fire
Heavy, visible film grain and dust specs
Muted, desaturated greens and blues in the environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The house is the central mass; the human figure is small, positioned in the lower right foreground, walking toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, overexposed center of the fire on the house roof.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright fire, follow the smoke upward, then drop to the figure walking away, finally settling on the corner typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant of the sky provides breathing room for the title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and muted blue (sky and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the fire vs. low saturation in the surroundings; high value contrast between the flames and the dark trees.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid clean, digital blacks; use lifted, grainy shadows

letterConstructionRules: Slightly distressed or blurred edges to match the film grain

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in the sky negative space

treatment.shadow: Soft outer glow or slight blur

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and placements for cohesion.
graphicDevices: Rectangular frame element within the text block

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif that handles distressing well.
Traditional feel that matches the vintage photography aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide shot of a small wooden house in a rural clearing at dusk, fully engulfed in large, bright orange and yellow flames with thick black smoke rising into a grainy, dark teal sky. A young man in a grey sweater and dark pants walks away from the house toward the camera in the foreground. Apply heavy 35mm film grain, dust, and scratches.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase serif text in the top right corner, stacked and center-aligned. Add a smaller line of the same serif text in the bottom left corner. Apply a slight blur and grain to the text to make it appear as part of the original film print.

verificationChecks: Is the fire the brightest point in the image?
Is the film grain visible across all elements?
Is the text color pure white but textured?
Does the figure look detached from the destruction?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact layout of the burning house structure
Proprietary logos or specific brand names

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between fire and negative space

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grain doesn't obscure the text legibility
Verify the color temperature contrast (warm vs cool)
Confirm the figure's scale feels grounded in the environment
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Destruction/Fire] with [Environment: Muted/Twilight] + [Texture: Heavy Film Grain] + [Typography: Classic High-Contrast Serif] for a melancholy cinematic aesthetic.
